verified_facts.text: The Kensington is located in the heart of South Kensington.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located in the heart of South Kensington, one of London’s most charming neighbourhoods

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits moments from The Royal Albert Hall, The Victoria and Albert Museum, Kensington Gardens and Harrods.
verified_facts.excerpt: sits only moments from near The Royal Albert Hall, The Victoria and Albert Museum, Kensington Gardens and the world-famous department store, Harrods

verified_facts.text: The hotel's drawing rooms feature open fires, high ceilings and heritage decor.
verified_facts.excerpt: Featuring open fires, high ceilings and heritage décor, the hotel’s elegant drawing rooms evoke a sense of Victorian grandeur

verified_facts.text: Lunch, dinner and Afternoon Tea are served in a Regency-period Town House setting.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Indulge in lunch, dinner or the quintessentially British tradition of
Afternoon Tea within the stunning environs of a regency period
Townhouse setting

verified_facts.text: The Afternoon Tea at Town House features confections inspired by works of art.
verified_facts.excerpt: Culture meets culinary excellence in our celebrated Afternoon Tea with delicious confections inspired by iconic art works.

verified_facts.text: The K Bar is an art deco bar serving cocktails and an expansive wine list.
verified_facts.excerpt:
discover delicious cocktails and our expansive wine list in the warm surrounds of the
K Bar

verified_facts.text: Guestrooms and suites blend period charm with modern comfort.
verified_facts.excerpt: suites at The Kensington reflect a delicate blend of period charm and modern comfort while the hotel’s signature suites take luxury to a new level

verified_facts.text: The Kensington is owned and managed by The Doyle Collection, an Irish family-owned luxury hotel group.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Kensington is owned and managed by The Doyle Collection, an Irish family-owned luxury hotel group

verified_facts.text: The hotel's address is 109 - 113 Queen's Gate, Kensington, London SW7 5LP.
The hotel is set in Victorian buildings in South Kensington.
verified_facts.excerpt: A handsome hotel set in Victorian buildings in elegant South Kensington

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a short walk from the Natural History Museum, Science Museum and V&A.
verified_facts.excerpt: It's a classic stucco-fronted Victorian pile a dinosaur’s stride from the Natural History Museum, Science Museum, and V&A.

verified_facts.text: The smaller rooms on the top floors are contemporary and streamlined.
verified_facts.excerpt: The small, contemporary rooms on the top floors are actually very chic and streamlined

verified_facts.text: The larger rooms are traditionally decorated, with features such as claw-foot baths, four-posters and working fireplaces.
verified_facts.excerpt: the larger rooms more traditionally and sumptuously decorated (heavy fabrics, claw-foot baths, four-posters, working fireplaces)

verified_facts.text: The two signature suites, the Kensington and the Brompton, are on the first floor.
verified_facts.excerpt: The two signature suites, the Kensington and the Brompton, on the first floor, are the pick of the litter.

verified_facts.text: Liveried Pashley bikes with flower-filled baskets are parked outside the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: The liveried Pashley bikes parked outside, their baskets festooned with flowers

verified_facts.text: Original artwork is displayed throughout the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: The original artwork throughout the hotel is terrific

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers a London with Family package that welcomes younger guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: There’s a warm welcome for our younger guests at The Kensington.
